Every way forward fails: going up, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves; going left, the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,3); going down would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So my guess (up from cell (3,1)) was wrong, so the line must go around the edge to (3,5).

Going around the edge to (2,1) would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going left, the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,3). So the line goes up.
Number 3 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going around the edge to (5,4) would leave number 4 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going down, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,3). So the line goes left.
Number 4 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Cell (2,4) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Going down, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (4,2). So the line goes left.
Going up would leave number 7 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes down.
Going down, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (4,3). So the line goes right.
Number 7 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going left would leave number 8 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes right.
Number 8 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
